name: Element Card
when_to_pick: Render a single content element with its role in the article made instantly legible. Pick variant 'essential' for the answer the searcher actually came for: an always-open, green-accented card with a role badge, the question it answers, a prominent answer heading, an optional label/value detail grid, and an optional source-attribution line — lift it into any section, an FAQ slot, or a TL;DR block. Pick variant 'complementary' for optional context that some readers want but most don't: a collapsible card with an 'Optional' role badge, a toggle title, body prose, and an optional supporting note; it stays collapsed by default (set open_by_default true to ship it expanded). Reach for this when you want one self-contained element whose importance is visually obvious, rather than a generic callout or a multi-row accordion (use accordion_faq for 3+ Q&A pairs).

variant.description: essential = always-open green-accented answer card. complementary = collapsible optional-context card.

question.description: essential only: the question this element answers, shown as an italic 'Q:' lead-in above the answer. Ignored for complementary.

heading.description: essential: the prominent answer heading (the payoff sentence). complementary: the collapsible toggle title. Required for both variants.

body.description:
complementary only: the body prose revealed when the card is expanded. Trusted inline HTML allowed (rendered with |safe) — keep to

///

    /
  • . Ignored for essential.

details.description: essential only: label/value pairs shown in a two-column detail grid below the answer. Use for realistic finance figures. Ignored for complementary.

value.description: Metric value, rendered in the mono numeric face, e.g. '$500' or '0.4%'.

source.description: essential only: the source-attribution line shown with a check tick at the bottom of the card, e.g. provenance of the figures. Ignored for complementary.

supporting.description: complementary only: an optional supporting/caveat note rendered as a soft-surface box at the end of the body. Trusted inline HTML allowed (rendered with |safe) — keep to <strong>/<em>. Ignored for essential.

open_by_default.description: complementary only: when true, the card ships expanded instead of collapsed. Ignored for essential (essential is always open).
